title.narrative: Enhancing the Impact of Rural Renewable Energy in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: In February 2020, Itochu Corporation announced a strategic investment in one of the RREP mini-grid operators, Winch Energy. In September 2019, Itochu Corporation also announced a US$40m investment in developing the largest pineapple producing and processing facility in Sierra Leone. The factory will be operated by Sierra Tropical Limited and its parent company, Dole Asia Holding Pte Limited and is expected to create over 3,000 Jobs in Sumbuya, near Bo in Sierra Leone. The Government of Japan is interested to support rural renewable energy mini-grids to compliment the mini-grids already developed under the Rural Renewable Energy Project (RREP) and to compliment the Japanese investments in the region. This support will enhance the sustainability of the project and the associated development outcomes.
